data.name: Freres Lumber
data.description: Freres Engineered Wood (formerly Freres Lumber Co.) is a family-owned Oregon wood products manufacturer founded in 1922 that produces plywood, veneers, lumber, and Mass Ply panels with ~450 employees. Biochar is generated as a byproduct of its Evergreen BioPower 100%-biomass-fired cogeneration boiler and was certified under the Puro.earth Biochar Methodology, with credits sold to Microsoft via ACT Commodities. The wood products business is the primary activity; CDR credits are an adjacent revenue stream.
